customManagers.description: hk's pkl schema version lives in hk.pkl's package URL, separate from the binary in mise.toml. A major bump of one without the other fails `hk check` with an opaque pkl eval error. Keep both in the same PR.

packageRules.description: @types/node tracks engines.node, not the newest LTS. Typechecking against 24's lib accepts APIs absent on the >=22.19.0 floor this package claims. Raise this ceiling in the same commit that raises engines.

peerDependency ranges ship in package.json. Widening one is a deliberate act: bump it, re-run the integration suite, type it feat: or fix: (CONTRIBUTING). The >= ranges mean Renovate skips them today anyway - this makes that structural instead of incidental.

The docs site under `docs/`. Its `dependencies` would take `fix(deps)` from config:recommended's :semanticPrefixFixDepsChoreOthers, and release-please cuts a patch release from a `fix` - so a Starlight or theme bump would publish an npm version whose `files` list does not even contain `docs/`. Docs dependencies never reach the package.
